principle: One canonical map of the fundamental primitives, organized by layer, each pointing to the REAL artifact that implements it. Assurance is first-class (the PMF wedge), not an afterthought. Non-destructive: this INDEXES the code; it does not move it.
pmf_alignment: DATA + STANDARD + RUNTIME are the substrate we share with every platform; ASSURANCE (verification/freshness/source-authority/receipts/governance) is where we differentiate — 'they standardize where context lives; Baltor governs whether it's true'.

primitive_families.definition: The typed atomic unit of data that flows through the system, with governance attached.
primitive_families.pmf_role: Every unit carries serves_truth + provenance — assurance rides on the unit, not bolted on.

primitive_families.definition: The FORMAT/medium a unit travels in (native shape, envelope, open knowledge/entity format).
primitive_families.pmf_role: Same-format-in/out + open-format interop = the on-ramp; we govern the contents above the medium.

primitive_families.definition: Where units rest: state log, memory, vector store, object/staging store.
primitive_families.pmf_role: Candidate≠promoted is enforced at the storage/promotion boundary.

primitive_families.definition: How units MOVE: event bus, work I/O, governed egress.
primitive_families.pmf_role: Egress is policy-bounded; transfer carries receipts, not raw trust.

primitive_families.definition: How units are TRANSFORMED: execution providers, workers, inference lanes.
primitive_families.pmf_role: LLM output is never truth — computation proposes, the assurance rail disposes.

primitive_families.definition: Open standards we adopt at the edges (single source of what we ingest/emit).
primitive_families.pmf_role: Format isn't the moat; we consume the open formats and add assurance.

primitive_families.definition: Context-grounding standards: the governed context object + its grammar.
primitive_families.pmf_role: They standardize where context lives; we govern whether it's true.

primitive_families.definition: Skill/capability standards: CapabilityTask + digested skills + the seed framework.
primitive_families.pmf_role: SKILL.md won the format war → adopt it as candidate import/export; the moat is governed lift.

primitive_families.definition: Compute backend selection by policy/telemetry (local/docker/k8s/cloud-fn behind one port).
primitive_families.pmf_role: Backends interchangeable behind a port; the FleetLedger stays truth.

primitive_families.definition: Kubernetes primitives (Job/Deployment-worker) with a built local equivalent (defer gate).
primitive_families.pmf_role: Cloud may be candidate; the local equivalent can never be missing.

primitive_families.definition: FaaS primitives (Cloud Run / Lambda / Azure Function) each with a local emulator.
primitive_families.pmf_role: Every live seam has a built local emulator → local_go_live_ready=True while cloud stays honest.

primitive_families.definition: The execution-environment profile + provisioning (the medium compute runs IN).
primitive_families.pmf_role: Environment is a typed, policy-bounded profile, not ad-hoc.

primitive_families.definition: The seven-primitive grammar: Input · Knowledge Corpus · If Statement · Action · Loop · Stop/End · Output.
primitive_families.pmf_role: The shared vocabulary every component decomposes into — version lives in metadata, never names.

primitive_families.definition: Measured lift + verification: does the component do what the model can't, provably?
primitive_families.pmf_role: The internal selection bar: admit on lift AND structural durability.

primitive_families.definition: Freshness/CDC currency: stale facts are held out, never served, until re-synced.
primitive_families.pmf_role: The wedge provers concede + gateways disclaim — answer currency.

primitive_families.definition: Earned source-authority + multi-source corroboration (not a fixture).
primitive_families.pmf_role: 'Independent authorities AGREE' — earned from provenance, the #1 differentiator.

primitive_families.definition: Portable receipts: every governed action emits a verifiable, backend-portable record.
primitive_families.pmf_role: Portable cross-vendor receipts — what data-gravity platforms don't emit.

primitive_families.definition: Policy + promotion + org guardrails bounding what the AI may do/heal/promote.
primitive_families.pmf_role: The AI fixes only within the org's confines; candidate never auto-promotes.
